outOfScope: Global scheduler, role registry or organization workflow graph.
Exactly-once event transport or transactional outbox as a correctness prerequisite.
Deployment, AcceptanceSnapshot or Product QA semantics.
Execution-policy or strategy selection inside the activation boundary.
constraints: Event or queue delivery is not lifecycle, claim or execution authority.
Activation is not strategy selection and is not obligation creation.
Queue, cursor and local backoff state are disposable and reconstructable from canonical work state.
A stale queued hint cannot resurrect invalidated work.
Frontend and Backend independence is governed by exact semantic dependencies, not global development stages.
A durable runtime such as Restate may host activation mechanics but cannot become organizational source of truth or hidden scheduler.
invariants: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work
architectureDecisions: Activation is level-triggered per owning domain; hints/scans only discover exact work and canonical state is reread before claim.
Key={projectId,workId,owningDomain}; trigger data grants no principal/claim/strategy/runtime/obligation/publication authority.
Canonical scans are recovery truth; disposable hint state cannot strand work; duplicates converge through claim/release + attempt currentness.
BB-052 must preserve requiredArtifactRefs and exact obligation-head currentness or BB-053 returns to RESEARCH_SA.
DomainExecutionInput is immutable content-addressed execution data; exactly one ref must match WorkContract owningDomain/workloadType.
DomainExecutionController resolves policy/strategy and passes exact WorkContract to its prebound adapter; activation never selects HOW.
BACKEND/FRONTEND have separate principals, hosts, controllers and adapters; shared stores provide CAS/currentness only.
Post-release reread of the same obligationSubjectKey+revision gates execution; drift fences claim with no attempt.
Parallel proof requires both FE/BE dispatch entered before either completes; host-local failure and exact invalidation cannot affect siblings.
implementationSlices: D1 — DomainExecutionInput [AC-5,AC-6]: immutable content-addressed {owningDomain,workloadType,repository,requiredFiles,constraints}; execution requires exactly one matching WorkContract artifact ref.

D2 — Controller seam [AC-2,AC-3,AC-4,INV-4]: pass exact WorkContract to the prebound runtime adapter; policy/strategy resolution, release validation, attempt binding and runtime attestation remain controller-owned.

D3A — Recovery/dedup [AC-1,AC-2,AC-7,INV-1,INV-2,INV-3]: scan listEligible(domain), reconcile exact key, recover via immediate/periodic scans, and converge duplicate hints through canonical claim/release + attempt currentness.
D3B — Domain admission [AC-3,INV-1,INV-3,INV-4,INV-5]: require host.domain=key.domain=WorkContract.domain before claim; hint fields grant no authority; mismatch has zero claim/attempt/dispatch.
D3C — Post-release fence [AC-4,INV-8]: reread the exact obligation subject+revision immediately before execute; non-ACTIVE/drift invalidates/fences only that claim and creates no attempt/dispatch.
D3D — Selective invalidation [AC-8,INV-8]: stale exact subject is NOOP/fenced; no global reset; unrelated current obligation remains scan-eligible/executable.
D4 — Backend adapter [AC-5,AC-6]: exact WorkContract+DomainExecutionInput -> BackendObjective; BackendApplication dispatch/recover; map WorkResult/artifacts/evidence to controller result.
D5 — Frontend adapter [AC-5,AC-6,INV-6,INV-7]: same adapter contract and recovery semantics as Backend, using only exact Frontend WorkContract+input and no Backend stage/session state.
D6A — Domain host [AC-1,AC-2,AC-7,INV-2,INV-3]: immediate+periodic canonical scan; notify is exact-domain latency hint; allSettled reconcile; stop drains only that host.
D6B — FE/BE composition [AC-5,AC-6,INV-6,INV-7]: independent hosts/controllers/adapters start with Promise.allSettled; neither awaits sibling completion; one host failure stays local.

D7 — Proofs [AC-1..AC-8,INV-1..INV-8]: barriers/counters prove parallel dispatch, zero-side-effect wrong-domain rejection, duplicate convergence, restart recovery, currentness drift fencing and sibling survival.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Queue, cursor, timer and hint state are disposable latency state and never canonical work truth.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation operates on exact work identities and cannot rank, schedule or choose a next role/domain.
evidenceRequired: activation exposes exact-key reconcile/domain scan only; no ranking/next-role/stage API

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation cannot select or override ExecutionPolicy, ExecutionStrategyDescriptor or runtime adapter.
evidenceRequired: activation passes only released-claim identity; controller still resolves policy/strategy/adapter

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation cannot create, mutate or make current a CrossDomainObligation.
evidenceRequired: activation has no obligation-write capability; forged obligation hint data is inert

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Frontend and Backend have no implicit stage barrier; only explicit semantic work dependencies may block actionability.
evidenceRequired: unrelated FE/BE both dispatch before completion; Frontend reads no Backend stage/session state

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Failure of one owning-domain host cannot cancel, gate or pause unrelated domain progress.
evidenceRequired: one adapter failure stays host-local; sibling reaches terminal

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A stale hint cannot resurrect work whose exact obligation/currentness became non-current.
evidenceRequired: non-current exact subject + stale hint -> no new claim/attempt/dispatch; unrelated work remains executable
